claim: The self-closing 'fix location' case was wrongly migrated from SlashToken to LessThanSlashToken; a LessThanSlashToken never has a JsxSelfClosingElement parent, so the branch is now dead and should be reverted to SlashToken.
raw: **1. completions.ts:3511 — self-closing "fix location" case was migrated incorrectly and is now unreachable.**

claim: The language-variant derivation reads only sourceFile?.languageVariant and does not mirror the text's fallback to node.getSourceFile(), so a call with sourceFile undefined would scan JSX text as Standard (latent, currently unreachable).
raw: The text falls back to `node.getSourceFile()` when `sourceFile` is `undefined`, but the variant only reads `sourceFile?.languageVariant` — it does *not* fall back to `node.getSourceFile().languageVariant`.

claim: The variant set/reset is not exception-safe: the reset to Standard runs only on the normal path, so a throw leaves the shared singleton scanner in JSX mode; use try/finally.
raw: **3. services.ts:509/530 — variant set/reset is not exception-safe.** The reset to `Standard` (line 530) runs only on the normal path. If the scan throws (e.g., the `Debug.fail` in `addSyntheticNodes`), the shared singleton scanner is left in JSX mode.

claim: The new optional languageVariant on SourceFileLike is public while its sibling optional members are @internal, so it enters the public API; the public-vs-@internal status should be a deliberate decision.
raw: **4. types.ts:4291 — new `languageVariant?` on `SourceFileLike` is public, unlike its siblings.** The two sibling optional members (`lineMap`, `getPositionOfLineAndCharacter`) are `@internal`; this new one is not, so it enters the public API.

claim: Add a fourslash completion test for a self-closing JSX element member/attribute position (e.g. `<UI.Test /* completion */ />`) — the self-closing path is untested, which is why the dead branch went unnoticed.
raw: - Fix issue #1 and add a small fourslash completion test for a self-closing JSX element member/attribute position (e.g., `<UI.Test /* completion */ />`) so the self-closing path is actually covered — its absence is why the dead branch went unnoticed.
